title: Sky3D
cue: day and night sky: sun, moon, stars, clouds, fog
summary: Day/night cycle for 3D scenes: a sky shader with sun, moon, stars, clouds and fog, sun and moon lights driven by game time, and exposure controls.
useWhen: A 3D game for desktop on Forward+ or Mobile needs a sky by date and place: sunrise, noon, sunset, and a starry night with the moon, with sunlight, shadows, and ambient light that follow the time, or a game clock with day and night.
avoidWhen: The game is released to the Web, where its sky comes out darker, sunlit walls burn out, and dusk goes nearly black (measured): WASD Look runs a day there that shows as on desktop. Or a fixed sky is enough, which needs no add-on.
